excluded_not_comparable.v22c_a050_beyond: 14 subsets, not the same 39 as every other run

no_variance_estimate.note: SURVIVES. Training-seed sd is 0.0004; the published gap of 0.0048 is 11.3 sd. The ranking is not a seed artifact.

reading: the negatives are the point. Prefix injection onto a warm start is catastrophic, regression on absolute cosines overfits, NLI labels are not similarity labels, and weight souping beat three separate training attempts at recovering English calibration.
